mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals a broad-based consumer demand contraction, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (INDPRO decline) during manufacturing slowdown periods, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (measured by retail sales, RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals rising consumer confidence and stronger corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand (RSAFS growth rate above 1.0% annually), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a shift in consumer spending patterns that reduces overall demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (HOUST decline) during strong consumer demand periods, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
